sections.heading: Live, learn, and innovate without boundaries
body: A Northeastern education is deeply rooted in real-world learning experiences through a global lens. As a student, you’ll find opportunities to collaborate, earn experience, experiment with AI, and solve problems throughout our global experiential network of campuses across the U.S., U.K., and Canada.

You design your journey according to your academic pursuits, curiosity, and career goals.

opportunities.title: Co-op
opportunities.excerpt: Co-op is our most immersive experiential opportunity, with students completing an average of two to three co-ops before graduation. A full-time, monthslong professional work experience that positions you not just for a job, but for your future.

image.alt: Co-op studnet in front of Bezos Center for innovation building

opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Co-op consulting
opportunities.excerpt: Open to undergraduates and graduate students, co-op consulting is a part-time experiential learning opportunity that’s integrated into a semesterlong course entirely centered around working on a real-world project for a company or organization.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Dialogue of Civilizations
opportunities.excerpt: Dialogues are faculty-led global learning experiences held during the summer that combine coursework, international travel, and cultural immersion.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Entrepreneurship
opportunities.excerpt: You’ll find endless opportunities to explore entrepreneurship, from launching your own startup to immersing yourself in Northeastern’s vast entrepreneurship ecosystem.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Experiential PhD
opportunities.excerpt: In all of our experiential PhD programs, you’ll have unique opportunities to take time outside of your research group to work in industry, government, or academia.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Experiential projects
opportunities.excerpt: Available to all students, experiential projects are real-world assignments from companies and organizations that are integrated into your coursework. You’ll learn about the organization’s unique challenges and work to deliver a solution.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Experiential Treks
opportunities.excerpt: Open to all undergraduate students, Experiential Treks are professional field trips and immersive learning experiences in which you gain insight into different career paths, and engage and network with professionals.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Kaleidoscope
opportunities.excerpt: Kaleidoscope is a student-led initiative that supports and unites undergraduate clubs in the Khoury College of Computer Sciences, and helps build connections and access to resources across the broader university community.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: London Scholars
opportunities.excerpt: London Scholars is a yearlong program for first-year undergraduates, in which you begin your Northeastern experience at our London campus, before continuing your education in Boston as a matriculated student.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Medical simulations labs
opportunities.excerpt: Open to healthcare and nursing students, medical simulation labs immerse you in the same real-world situations and processes that you’ll find in hospitals and other clinical settings.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Mosaic
opportunities.excerpt: Mosaic is a peer-to-peer community of students who are innovators and passionate about entrepreneurship. This community provides services that help students start their own businesses, exchange ideas, and grow entrepreneurship opportunities across our campuses.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: N.U.in
opportunities.excerpt: N.U.in is a program in which you spend your first semester at Northeastern studying abroad at one of our many partner institutions alongside a group of other first-year students, before continuing your education in Boston in your second semester.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Noncredit research
opportunities.excerpt: Experiential research involves applying theoretical knowledge to real-world problems. At Northeastern, you’ll find extracurricular research opportunities that match your interests.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: NU VIEW
opportunities.excerpt: Open to first- and second-year students, Northeastern’s Virtual Integrated Experiential Workshop, or NU VIEW, is a free, noncredit four-week program that enables you to build your skills and experience as you complete a project with a corporate or enterprise sponsor.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: NYC Scholars
opportunities.excerpt: Held in partnership with Marymount Manhattan College, New York City Scholars is a yearlong program for first-year students, in which you begin your Northeastern experience at our New York City campus.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Semester In
opportunities.excerpt: Through this program for undergraduates, you’ll spend a semester studying alongside other Northeastern students at one of our locations in the U.S., U.K., or Canada. Your program will have a targeted academic and experiential focus.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Service learning
opportunities.excerpt: Service learning is a rigorous form of experiential learning through which you’ll engage in hands-on service to address community needs.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Student clubs and organizations
opportunities.excerpt: Get involved on your campus by joining one of our 600+ student groups. You’ll grow your interests, strengthen your sense of belonging on campus, and develop new capabilities that you’ll bring to your classes and your career.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Study abroad
opportunities.excerpt: In this immersive global experience, you’ll take courses at a partner university for a semester in a country outside the U.S.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Summer In
opportunities.excerpt: Through this program for undergraduates, you’ll spend a summer studying alongside other Northeastern students at one of our locations in the U.S., U.K., or Canada. Your program will have a targeted academic and experiential focus.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Three Seas
opportunities.excerpt: Three Seas is a yearlong, field-intensive program in which you’ll study marine biology and habitats across three coastal environments.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: U.K. apprenticeships
opportunities.excerpt: Offered through Northeastern University London, degree apprenticeships are for residents of the U.K. or Ireland, whether you’re a working professional seeking to upskill or reskill in your career, or a student who has completed secondary school.
opportunities.detailPage: Stub only: H1 title + featured image, robots noindex. Not linked from listing (CTA goes to external URL).

opportunities.title: Undergraduate research
